payload.summary: Planned phase 3: packed review packets as default input, concurrent vendor dispatch implementing the existing parallel SHALL, and verify-then-wire structured-output flags. Does not wait on dg-02.

decisions.title: Packet not repo-walk
decisions.rationale: Timeouts are a symptom of tool-using exploration; pack diff, specs, schema, open ledger.

decisions.title: Concurrent CLI dispatch
decisions.rationale: The spec already SHALL parallel; sequential was a write-conflict guard that does not apply to read-only review.

decisions.title: Verify-then-wire structured output
decisions.rationale: Do not guess CLI flags; only verified rows change agents.yaml.

next_steps: Depends on phase 1. Prefers phase 2 for smaller packets. Gate 2 approval, then implement.
